summary: Reviewed the migration, seed parser, API, and item-detail UI. SQL is rerun-safe and follows the 004 RLS/grant pattern; delete-then-insert keeps positions idempotent; the grouped UI handles flat fallback, null-item rows, and the collapsed 'Other items' list correctly.

findings.issue: APStats Practice/Optional labels did not resolve to existing ids.
findings.detail: The resolver only tried `${lesson_code}-savvas-qN`. APStats registry ids are `apstats-6-4-explore-q1` / `...-reinforcement-q1`, so those rows would seed as unmatched even when a real item exists.

findings.issue: APStats lesson ids could not load items in the detail pane.
findings.detail: `itemsForLesson()` only converted `L35_P2`-style ids. `APStats_6-4_P1` was querying `items.lesson = APStats_6-4_P1` instead of `APStats-6-4`, so valid phase rows rendered as unmatched/non-clickable.
Current teacher packets also include nearby Exit headers, so rows still land correctly now. A future phasetag-only exit section would be misclassified.

edits: Updated `supabase/seed_lesson_phases.py` so `Practice #N` / `Optional #N` can fall back to lesson-scoped `qN` ids, preferring `explore` and `reinforcement` ids respectively.
